releasePlan.notes: Roles: shift2-enable-greeting-refresh-error-rate = killswitch, shift2-enable-greeting-refresh-latency = pause, shift2-enable-greeting-refresh-success-rate = monitoring. Latency is two-armed (server-side page render duration is tracked on both control and v1). The error and success events come from the v1 page's sendBeacon only, so those two are one-armed: control renders no refresh button and emits neither. No autogenerated otel* metrics exist in this project, and the sentry-errors-* metrics are backend-only, so track() is the only valid backing for this frontend flag.
